answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with per-identity staked bonds and slashing: before an agent may mint attestations or claim work it locks a bond bound to one verified key, and the chain refuses to let that same bond back a second key. Duplicates caught colluding forfeit everything, so the attacker's bill rises with every forged identity. A velvet slogan buys no stake, a hollow swarm of unbacked keys earns no trust, and only bonded agents may graze the meadow of rewards. Ten thousand Sybils demand ten thousand bonds, so flooding the network becomes a losing trade.
